<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 6:6">Targ. Job VI, 6</cite>.—
<cite ref="Ketubot 77b:4">Keth. 77ᵇ</cite> (describing <cite ref="T00039"><he>רַאֲתָן</he></cite>) <he>איתי ליה ר׳ וכ׳</he> slaver comes out of his mouth on which flies settle.

<cite ref="Chullin 77a:9">Ḥull. 77ᵃ</cite> <he>דקני משכא רִירֵיה</he> Ar. (v. Tosaf. a. l.; ed. <he>דקנה משכא דידיה</he>) when the skin over the fracture retains the discharge of the broken bone (ed. when the skin holds its own place).
<cite ref="Chullin 77a:9">Ib.</cite> <he>דקנא גרמא ריריה</he> Mus. in Ar. ed. Koh. (ed. <he>דידיה</he>) when the broken bone retains its discharge.
<cite ref="Beitzah 22a:13">Bets. 22ᵃ</cite> <he>ר׳</he> discharge of a sore eye; <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 28b:12">Ab. Zar. 28ᵇ</cite>.—Pl. <he>רִירִין</he>.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Terumot 8:3:34">Y. Ter. VIII, 46ᵃ</cite> top <he>עברת ר׳ עלוי ופסקתיה</he> (the serpent nibbling at the melon) passed slaver over it and cut through it (made the poison go through it).
